remarks: A circular driveway welcomes you to this exceptional custom residence, perfectly positioned on a breathtaking lot overlooking the Niagara Escarpment. Blending timeless craftsmanship with modern comforts, this one-of-a-kind fully solar powered home offers stunning views, remarkable entertaining spaces & quality finishes throughout. From the moment you enter through the beautiful solid wood front door, you'll appreciate the rich natural woodwork, soaring ceilings, elegant hardwood floors & meticulous attention to detail. The kitchen features imported luxury flooring, solid wood cabinetry with crown molding, granite countertops & stainless steel appliances, including a smart refrigerator & double ovens. The adjoining breakfast room offers custom built-ins, crown molding, a vaulted ceiling & sliding glass doors leading to a Trex deck overlooking the expansive backyard & spectacular escarpment views. Designed for entertaining, the formal dining room features a lovely bay window, hardwood floors, a wood-burning fireplace & a door leading to a charming terrace. The spectacular family room is the centerpiece of the home, boasting soaring cathedral ceilings with exposed wood beams, a dramatic floor-to-ceiling stone gas fireplace & a wet bar featuring cabinetry reclaimed from the historic Buffalo Chocolate Factory. Walls of windows frame incredible views, while elegant chandeliers & wall sconces add warmth & sophistication. Sliding glass doors lead to a spacious concrete patio featuring an outdoor oven. The first floor also includes a bedroom with abundant natural light, recessed lighting & a full bath. The impressive second floor addition features a luxurious primary suite complete with a sitting area, custom barn door, double sinks, a tiled walk-in shower, imported fixtures, walk-in closet & a relaxing soaker tub. Three additional bedrooms provide space for family, guests, an office or den. Beautifully appointed & thoughtfully designed, the second floor is completed by a full bath serving the additional bedrooms. A rare opportunity to own a distinctive home set atop the iconic Niagara Escarpment, where breathtaking panoramic views showcase the natural beauty of Lewiston
